text:
Silver Price in 1998
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1998, the LBMA silver price fell 17.2% between 1998-01-30 ($6.05) and 1998-12-31 ($5.01). The highest sampled price was $6.37 in February and the lowest was $4.79 in August. The mean of these observations was $5.50. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
